findings.text: follow-on: observe_log reads the login record from Path(log_path).parent, while launch_plan writes it to Path(manifest).parent at reckon/_backends.py:3172 and :3235, so for a run whose manifest is declared outside its run directory the two disagree and a blanked login is never reported through that run's observation; the default layout, which the tests cover, makes them the same directory.

justifications.fit: the new helpers at reckon/_backends.py:2512-2630 sit beside claude_credential_source and _harness_credential_binds in the module's credential idiom and introduce no name the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:2564 observe_codex_login compares the recorded before-size with a post-run stat and reports a zero on the run's record and stderr, meeting section 7's truncation arm, and tests/test_fenced_codex_can_persist_its_login.py:299 and :322 assert removal and replacement are refused, though the report is only reachable where the record and the stream share a directory.
